question: Does the Phase 74 DINOv3 Kandinsky-aware system catch at least 80% of fresh Kandinsky 2.2 images, including images from scene prompts never used in development, while calling at most 3% of fresh real eBay photos FAKE?
scope_limit: Real photograph versus AI-generated image only. No physical-counterfeit or authenticity claim. Kandinsky 2.2 is a SEEN generator in Phase 74 (its images and its MoVQ autoencoder are used in development); this is not an unseen-generator result.
literature_basis: Rajan et al., Aligned Datasets Improve Detection of Latent Diffusion-Generated Images, ICLR 2025 (arXiv 2410.11835): train on real photos versus their own autoencoder reconstructions
Ricker et al., AEROBLADE, CVPR 2024 (arXiv 2401.17879): autoencoder reconstruction distance
Cozzolino et al., Raising the Bar of AI-generated Image Detection with CLIP, CVPRW 2024 (arXiv 2312.00195): few-shot linear heads on frozen foundation features
Rethinking Cross-Generator Image Forgery Detection through DINOv3 (arXiv 2511.22471): frozen DINOv3 patch tokens with a linear probe
Koutlis and Papadopoulos, RINE, ECCV 2024: intermediate-layer foundation features
Grommelt et al., Fake or JPEG?, ECCVW 2024 (arXiv 2403.17608): identical JPEG and size handling for both classes
Chen et al., DRCT, ICML 2024; Guillaro et al., B-Free, CVPR 2025; Park and Owens, Community Forensics, CVPR 2025: reconstruction-aligned and diverse training data
development_data: benchmark_v1, benchmark_v2 and benchmark_v3 (all groups), Label_0 train/validation photos, and a new Kandinsky 2.2 training set (group kandinsky22_train, seeds base 78000, scene templates T1-T8 only, stored apart from benchmark_v4). benchmark_v4 is used once.

classes.REAL_PHOTO: real_ebay_v4: primary image of eBay listings (Browse API, category 31387, price >= 1000 USD, five brands), up to 60 per brand, excluding every listing and image in benchmark_v1, v2 or v3 and every training image. Minimum 30 per brand.

GENERATED.kandinsky22_v4: PRIMARY. kandinsky-community/kandinsky-2-2-decoder, 768 px, 50 steps, guidance 4.0, seeds base 76000, 60 per brand. Scenes alternate between the eight development templates T1-T8 and eight new templates T9-T16 that no development or training image used (30 + 30 per brand).
GENERATED.stable_cascade_v4: SECONDARY (regression check). Same Stable Cascade lite settings as benchmark_v3, seeds base 77000, templates T1-T8, 60 per brand. A development generator since Phase 73 scoring.

normalisation: Same as benchmark_v2 and v3: centre-crop square, Lanczos to 512 x 512, JPEG q90, metadata stripped; sources below 512 px excluded.
no_peeking: No model, OCR or fusion output may be computed on benchmark_v4 images until ml_rtx5080/experiments/kandinsky_v4/fusion_rule.json is written and its SHA-256 recorded in benchmark_v4_fresh/score.py. Generated or collected benchmark_v4 images are not opened for viewing.

systems_compared.dinov3_alone: fine-tuned DINOv3 epoch_018, calibrated P(fake) (T = 0.2404), benchmark policy as in benchmark_v3
systems_compared.dinov3_kandinsky_v4: Phase 74 system frozen in experiments/kandinsky_v4/fusion_rule.json: FAKE, REVIEW, AUTHENTIC

primary_analysis.generated_caught: FAKE decisions, Clopper-Pearson 95% intervals; also reported separately for T1-T8 and T9-T16 scenes
primary_analysis.real_rejected: real photos decided FAKE, with intervals; REVIEW reported separately and never counted as caught or rejected
primary_analysis.paired: exact McNemar, dinov3_kandinsky_v4 vs dinov3_alone, on generated images where both give a binary decision

success_criterion: On the primary set, dinov3_kandinsky_v4 calls at least 80.0% of kandinsky22_v4 images FAKE, and calls at most 3.0% of real_ebay_v4 photos FAKE.
